# multi-agent-router

> Route tasks to specialist agents by rules, lexical intent scores and an optional LLM classifier, with fallback, explained decisions and bounded handoffs Python package `trysac-multi-agent-router`, import name `multi_agent_router`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
